title: NASA Plans Nuclear Fission Reactor on Lunar Surface to Power Long-Duration Moon Missions
detail: NASA is advancing plans to build a nuclear fission reactor on the lunar surface, intended to power long-duration moon missions and prepare for future Mars exploration. The initiative is part of NASA's broader Artemis infrastructure strategy to establish sustained human presence on the Moon, with nuclear fission offering a reliable power source independent of solar conditions in permanently shadowed regions.

media.caption: NASA's plans for a nuclear fission reactor on the lunar surface to support long-duration missions
